newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas volume higher but only four months traded.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas volume higher but only four months traded.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures saw 205 lots traded in total on Wednesday, the best day so far this week in terms of volume, but trade was still limited to only four of the twelve monthly contracts.
"There was good interest in September and October," said a futures broker, "they caused most of the excitement."

September saw 90 lots traded, with the final deal done at 10.575 pence a therm, up 0.05 pence from Tuesday's close. Another 60 lots traded in October, closing at 12.205, down 0.060 pence from the previous settlement price.

A broker said that towards the end of the afternoon there was a lot of serious interest seen for several periods, with bids and offers moving closer together at the end of the last session. But the market was still thin compared with some recent days, although prices remained volatile with some months up and others down.

Apart from the keen interest seen in September and October, the only other trades seen were in front month April, off 0.10 pence to close at 10.20, and December, which saw a trade in the minute before the market closed to end down 0.475 pence a therm at 14.00 pence.
